title: 第26章 魔道计划第27章 变身之术
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
雷雄林笑道：“这都是陈师兄的功劳，因为你赐予我们的筑基丹，我们才得以进入真武境，对此，我们万分感激。”
连明东道：“陈师兄，您的大恩，我们真是感激不尽。以后，如果您需要我们帮忙，无论是什么，尽管说。”
雷忠傻笑道：“我没脑子，但我有力量，以后我一定会报答陈师兄的。”
云小刀等人暗暗佩服沉翔的手段。他们三人都已经进入了真武境，现在对沉翔都是忠诚的。别人的年轻随从多了很多，但他们的随从都只有凡武境十级。虽然数量更多，但加起来，依然无法和真武境一重的武者相比。
沉翔呵呵一笑，问道：“你们吃了多少筑基丹？”
“一！”
连明东三人只吃了一个；由此可见，他们的潜力有多大。他们只是卡在了凡武境的瓶颈，但如果全力修炼十二十年，哪怕没有筑基丹，最终也能进入真武境。
“你们都在这里！长老让我来集合你们。”
郝冬青走了进来。
连明东等人才刚刚踏入真武境两三天，就已经和吴开明以及院长见面了。
因为他们三人都刚刚踏入真武境，前往南荒对于他们来说，是极其危险的。当然，沉翔从一开始就不想让这三个新人冒着生命危险去猎杀魔道武者。去南荒不仅仅是为了比赛，否则的话，也没必要去南荒。如果愿意的话，他们完全可以在南荒找个安全的地方，隐藏起来，以求活命。最后，谁的生存人数多，谁就能成为胜利者。
这就是为什么最大的挑战是生存；在那片危险的土地上生存并避免被追捕。这些是最关键的。不过沉翔还是不明白，为什么魔道宗会提出要去那里。
吴开明的院子里，包括陈翔等人在内，一共有十个人。他也看到了吴芊芊，不过，这里还有几位长老，还有院长在场，他也不能就这么过去说话。
“人都到了！唉，说实话，此行对于你们这些年轻人来说，尤其是刚刚踏入真武境不久的年轻人来说，是非常危险的。”
顾东辰叹了口气。
丹长老道：“要不，我去，把那些胆小的家伙都带过来吧。如果十名真武五重武者都去的话，那就是最强大的阵容了！”
古东辰摇头，“不用了，其他人不一定会派出最强的弟子，魔道宗也未必会派出自己最强大的弟子。我们都知道，这场比赛是魔道宗提出的，双方都时间和地点都由他们决定，而且，这次比赛的目的并不是比拼实力，而是比拼谁能活得更久。”
吴开明点了点头，道：“如果论实力的话，那些魔道弟子并不比我们强多少，否则的话，他们也不会这么麻烦！他们提出的比试地点是在南荒山脉，或许是因为他们的适应能力比较强，也能利用地形和各种危险来偷袭我们的人。”
沉翔同意道：“是的，也许他们根本不需要行动，人肯定会死在那里。如果他们的生存能力比我们强，说不定最后他们都会活下来，到时候他们一定会死的。”赢！这样一来，他们就能轻松战胜那些比他们更强的武者，而且一路上还能坐等敌人几个真武境武者的死亡。
古东辰道：“所以你去那里的时候，不要以为一定要冒着生命危险去杀死对方。当然，如果是一个人的话，大家齐心协力就可以杀死他。不过，注意一点注意他们是否设置了任何陷阱！”

“正宗之中，我们太武宗派出的人数最多，兽武宗和真武宗只派出了四人，丹香桃源和神兵天帝国各派了七人，至于剩下的莲花岛、冰风谷和傲剑宗，都只是各派出六人而已。”
吴开明说道：“我们派了十个人去，至于团队合作，沉翔必须把你们全部留下。这家伙是个麻烦分子，而且他还有一千五百万的悬赏金，所以无论是正道还是魔道，都可以。”会盯着他的头”
沉翔嘴角微微抽搐，不过，吴开明等人命令他做的，也是正确的决定。否则，他就会影响整个团队。云小刀和雷雄霖等人却有些不情愿。他们都崇拜沉翔，都想着要和沉翔一起遨游人间。不过，他们也得听古东辰的。
“沉翔，你一个人行动，你有朱雀火翼，战斗经验丰富，杀了比你强很多的人！你去那里的目的就是为了杀掉魔道武者，同时也，保护其他宗门的弟子，当正宗弟子受到攻击的时候，你需要出来救援！至于其他九人，你们就待在一起，不能分开。在接下来的三个月里，我们会训练你，让你行动协调。”
顾东辰说话了。
沉翔突然想到神兵天帝国和冰风谷是不是要派出薛仙仙和冷幽兰。两人在同辈中都颇有实力，也是各自宗门培养的重点。
沉翔心里有些矛盾；如果他们在那里，他会很高兴，因为他可以见到他们。但同时，他也有些担心；如果他们去了那里，那么他们肯定会面临危险。想来想去，他觉得那两个人还是不要去那里比较好，因为那里太危险了。他祈祷柳梦儿不要派他们来。
“好，现在你们就跟老长老去一处秘地修炼，沉翔你留下来，我们有话要告诉你。”
顾东辰说道。
云小刀等八人跟着一个驼背老者走了出去。待他们走后，吴开明这才开口道：“少师叔，你怎么突然找到了三个刚刚踏入真武境的武者？如果他们加入，那你就是杀了他们，这三个人的实力都不错。”基础。”
“肯定是少师伯给了他们筑基丹。”
丹长老在一旁说道。
吴开明和古东辰都不知道沉翔有这么多筑基丹。他们也不知道沉翔能够炼制筑基丹。沉翔掌握着如此多的筑基丹，若是传出去，恐怕整个辰武大陆都会震动。
古东辰和吴开明立即认为沉翔是在发展自己的势力。这样做无论如何都没有错。
沉翔笑道：“我也不隐瞒了，师叔知道如何炼制筑基丹，如果你想要的话，我可以便宜一点卖给你，只要五十万晶石就可以了。”一个。如果你愿意，你只需要说一句话。”
“什么！？”古东辰惊呼一声，他没想到沉翔竟然能够炼制筑基丹！
吴凯明也愣住了，盯着陈赛恩。他和古东辰虽然不知道如何炼丹，但也知道炼制筑基丹有多么困难。最重要的是，炼金术士必须不浪费足够的材料。
“这是真的！”
丹长老冷哼一声，心中却暗自窃笑。沉翔分明是想骗顾东辰和吴开明，她知道，对于沉翔来说，获得筑基丹根本不算什么。
content_en:
Lei Xionglin smiled and said: "This is all thanks to Senior Brother Chen. Because of the Foundation Establishment Pill you gave us, we were able to enter the True Martial Realm. For this, we are extremely grateful."
Lian Mingdong said: "Senior Brother Chen, we are really grateful for your great kindness. In the future, if you need our help, no matter what it is, just ask."
Lei Zhong giggled and said, "I have no brains, but I have strength. I will definitely repay Senior Brother Chen in the future."
Yun Xiaodao and others secretly admired Chen Xiang's methods. All three of them have entered the True Martial Realm and are now loyal to Chen Xiang. Others have many more young followers, but their followers are only at the tenth level of the Mortal Martial Realm. Although there are more, in total, they are still unable to compare with the warriors at the first level of the True Martial Realm.
Chen Xiang chuckled and asked, "How many Foundation Establishment Pills have you taken?"
"One!"
Lian Mingdong and the other three only ate one; this shows how great their potential is. They are just stuck at the bottleneck of the Mortal Martial Realm, but if they practice hard for twelve years, they can eventually enter the True Martial Realm even without the Foundation Establishment Pill.
"You are all here! The elder asked me to gather you."
Hao Dongqing walked in.
Lian Mingdong and others had just entered the Zhenwu Realm for two or three days, and they had already met Wu Kaiming and the dean.
Because the three of them had just entered the True Martial Realm, it was extremely dangerous for them to go to the Southern Wilderness. Of course, Chen Xiang did not want these three newcomers to risk their lives to hunt down demonic warriors from the beginning. Going to Southern Wilderness is not just for the competition. Otherwise, there is no need to go to Southern Wilderness. If they wanted to, they could find a safe place in the Southern Wasteland and hide in order to survive. In the end, whoever has the most survivors will be the winner.
That's why the biggest challenge is survival; survive in that dangerous land and avoid being hunted. These are the most critical. However, Chen Xiang still didn't understand why the Demonic Dao Sect proposed to go there.
There were ten people in Wu Kaiming's yard, including Chen Xiang and others. He also saw Wu Qianqian, but there were several elders and the dean present here, so he couldn't just go over and talk.
"Everyone is here! Alas, to be honest, this trip is very dangerous for you young people, especially those who have just entered the true martial arts realm."
Gu Dongchen sighed.
Elder Dan said: "How about I go and bring all those timid guys here. If all ten true fifth-level warriors go, it will be the most powerful lineup!"
Gu Dongchen shook his head, "No, other people may not necessarily send their strongest disciples, and the Demonic Sect may not necessarily send their strongest disciples. We all know that this competition was proposed by the Demonic Sect, and the time and location of both parties are decided by them. Moreover, the purpose of this competition is not to compete for strength, but to see who can live longer."
Wu Kaiming nodded and said: "In terms of strength, those demon disciples are not much stronger than us. Otherwise, they would not be so troublesome! The location they proposed for the competition is in the Southern Wilderness Mountains. Perhaps it is because they have strong adaptability and can use terrain and various dangers to sneak attack our people."
Chen Xiang agreed: "Yes, maybe they don't need to act at all, people will definitely die there. If their survival ability is better than ours, maybe they will survive in the end, and they will definitely die by then." Win! In this way, they can easily defeat those warriors who are stronger than them, and they can also wait for the death of several enemy True Martial Realm warriors along the way.
Gu Dongchen said: "So when you go there, don't think that you have to risk your life to kill the other person. Of course, if it is one person, everyone can kill him by working together. However, be careful and pay attention to whether they have set any traps!"
"Among the authentic, our Taiwu Sect sent the largest number of people, Beast Martial Sect and Zhenwu Sect only sent four people, Danxiang Taoyuan and Shenbingtian Empire each sent seven people, and as for the remaining Lotus Island, Icewind Valley and Proud Sword Sect, they only sent six people each. "
Wu Kaiming said: "We sent ten people, as for teamwork, Chen Xiang must keep all of you. This guy is a troublemaker, and he has a 15 million bounty on his head, so it doesn't matter if he's on the right path or the devil's path. "Watching his head"
The corner of Chen Xiang's mouth twitched slightly, but what Wu Kaiming and others ordered him to do was also the right decision. Otherwise, he will affect the entire team. Yun Xiaodao, Lei Xionglin and others were somewhat reluctant. They all admire Chen Xiang and want to travel the world with Chen Xiang. However, they also have to listen to Gu Dongchen.
"Chen Xiang, you are acting alone. You have Suzaku Fire Wings and have rich fighting experience. You have killed people who are much stronger than you! The purpose of your going there is to kill the demonic warriors, and at the same time, to protect the disciples of other sects. When the authentic disciples are attacked, you need to come out to rescue! As for the other nine people, you stay together and cannot be separated. In the next three months, we will train you to coordinate your actions."
Gu Dongchen spoke.
Chen Xiang suddenly thought whether the Divine Weapon Empire and Icewind Valley were going to send Xue Xianxian and Leng Youlan. Both of them are quite powerful among their peers and are the focus of training in their respective sects.
Chen Xiang felt somewhat conflicted; if they were there, he would be happy because he could see them. But at the same time, he was a little worried; if they went there, they would definitely be in danger. After much deliberation, he felt that it was better for the two people not to go there because it was too dangerous. He prayed that Liu Meng'er would not send them.
"Okay, now you go to a secret place to practice with the old elder. Chen Xiang, you stay here, we have something to tell you."
Gu Dongchen said.
Yun Xiaodao and the other eight people followed a hunchbacked old man out. After they left, Wu Kaiming said: "Uncle Young Master, why did you suddenly find three warriors who have just stepped into the true martial arts realm? If they join, then you will kill them. These three people are all good." Basic. "
"It must have been the Young Master who gave them the Foundation Building Pill. "
Elder Dan said from the side.
Neither Wu Kaiming nor Gu Dongchen knew that Chen Xiang had so many Foundation Building Pills. They also didn't know that Chen Xiang could refine the Foundation Building Pill. Chen Xiang has so many foundation-building pills in his hands. If word spreads, the entire Chenwu Continent may be shaken.
Gu Dongchen and Wu Kaiming immediately thought that Chen Xiang was developing his own power. There is nothing wrong with doing this in any way.
Chen Xiang smiled and said: "I won't hide it anymore. Uncle Master knows how to refine the Foundation Establishment Pill. If you want it, I can sell it to you cheaper. It only costs 500,000 crystal stones." "One. If you want, you just have to say a word."
"What!?" Gu Dongchen exclaimed, he didn't expect Chen Xiang to be able to refine the Foundation Establishment Pill!
Wu Kaiming was also stunned and stared at Chen Saien. Although he and Gu Dongchen didn't know how to refine elixirs, they also knew how difficult it was to refine foundation-building elixirs. Most importantly, the alchemist must not waste enough materials.
"It's true!"
Elder Dan snorted coldly, but secretly chuckled in his heart. Chen Xiang clearly wanted to deceive Gu Dongchen and Wu Kaiming. She knew that for Chen Xiang, obtaining the Foundation Establishment Pill was nothing.
